name: Respond to Webhook
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Respond to Webhook node to control the response to incoming webhooks. This node works with the Webhook node

parameters.name: Respond With
parameters.description: Choose what data to send in the webhook response
options: All Incoming Items: Respond with all the JSON items from the input
Binary File: Respond with a binary file defined in Response Data Source
First Incoming Item: Respond with the first incoming item's JSON
JSON: Respond with a JSON object defined in Response Body
JWT Token: Respond with a JSON Web Token (JWT)
Redirect: Redirect to a URL set in Redirect URL

parameters.name: Response Code
parameters.description: Set the response code to use

parameters.name: Response Headers
parameters.description: Define the response headers to send

parameters.name: Put Response in Field
parameters.description: Available when you respond with All Incoming Items or First Incoming Item. Set the field name for the field containing the response data

parameters.name: Enable Streaming
parameters.description: When enabled, sends the data back to the user using streaming. Requires a trigger configured with the Response mode Streaming

parameters.name: enableResponseOutput
parameters.description: Whether to provide an additional output branch with the response sent to the webhook

parameters.name: generalNotice
parameters.displayName: Verify that the "Webhook" node's "Respond" parameter is set to "Using Respond to Webhook Node". <a href="https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/core-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.respondtowebhook/" target="_blank">More details
